subject: [PATCH v3 0/2] zstd: use x86 feature infrastructure for BMI2 dispatch

reviews.author: Dhruva Gole
reviews.summary: Raised concerns about the fragility of including <asm/cpufeature.h> in zstd_deps.h, suggesting that it would be better to include it directly in each .c file. Provided a Reviewed-by tag.

2026-09-02.patch_summary: This patch series improves the zstd compression library's performance on x86 CPUs by leveraging the kernel's CPU feature infrastructure to dispatch BMI2 instructions instead of relying on raw CPUID probes. The patches introduce aliases for BMI2 function names and modify the runtime selectors to use cpu_feature_enabled() at each dispatch site, reducing unnecessary feature tests and improving performance.
